scope: Local official API adapter and session-aware question/search/original-review connection. No new AI report or operational source change.

modes.plan: Default; no credential read, request, model or file write.
modes.replay: Explicit private snapshot and reviewed methodology PDF; no credential read or network.
modes.collect: Explicit local token file, reviewed methodology PDF, dates and PowerShell path; at most one request, no retry or fallback. This mode was tested with synthetic transport, not called live again in this task.

implementation.probeCompatibility: Existing diagnostic CLI and exported parser names are preserved via the shared source module.
commonConnections: prepareOfficialClpResearch retains existing numeric calculations and report packet shape
researchPlan includes versioned question time scopes and transaction-date query text
runResearch hands the same scopes to the existing public search collector
replayResearchCollection uses the same search scopes
inspectDossier checks same-day and earlier-context event dates against the relevant question anchor
collectOriginal reports article publication relation to the transaction day and aggregation cutoff
failClosed: Recompute saved session labels from effective dates; do not trust a saved localSessionDate
Unmapped latest observation blocks default preparation instead of selecting an older price
Explicit historical-session selection remains possible and retains its actual observedDate
Changed methodology, invalid snapshots and not-yet-available observations are rejected
Publication time is not event time; article timing never grants direct-cause approval
Public search transport failure is not recorded as absence of market news

replay.exclusionReason: Previous banking day not established at capture boundary or blank weekday; no holiday inference.

marketLocalGlobalCounter.role: Market explanation candidates; original event, price basis and attribution review still required.

consumer.role: Sales environment background; search publication window does not establish the statistic target period or a daily FX cause.

watch.role: Subsequent context, including weekend news; cannot explain earlier price movements automatically.

timePolicy.legacyPackets: No official reportPriceBasis means previous report-date search policy remains available.
timePolicy.calendarMethod: IANA America/Santiago DST conversion; no fixed UTC offset.
timePolicy.intradayLimit: Search covers local calendar days, not exact historical publication availability. Aggregation cutoff is not a single quote time.

realNewsProbe.limitation: This is a local transport failure, not evidence that GDELT is generally unavailable or that no relevant articles exist. No alternate source was silently admitted.

checks.testInventory: No exact duplicate names/bodies or detected tautologies. This does not prove semantic uniqueness or real AI quality.
checks.bundleBoundary: passed; production entry remains 610348 bytes; existing chunk-size warning remains
checks.appSpecificBuild: Not repeated; no app UI or app build configuration change in this task.
checks.database: Not touched or tested in this task.

secretScan.scope: public, production/report/app build outputs, report scripts, 2.0 docs and initial new private replay/search results
secretScan.method: Compare actual local token and URL-encoded form internally; print counts only

remaining: Resolve public-news transport or explicitly use the registered publisher discovery path; verify original passages for the selected transaction days.
Review news event time, article publication/modification times and price basis separately; metadata and IDs alone do not prove causal support.
Methodology uses the previously reviewed PDF hash, not a newly verified current revision.
Short date range does not provide a full 3-month chart, prior-month comparison or 52-week history; missing metrics must not be fabricated.
Official API attribution and adaptation-responsibility metadata are prepared, but public UI attribution and full publication readiness remain separate work.
Local snapshots are not cryptographically signed historical archives.
